description: Plan ID. A 7 digit integer. It refers to an optimization plan.
Plan week. A week in which plan was active. Year-week number in yyyyww fromat.
Department number. A double digit integer. It refers to a department.
Plan created date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
Out Of Stock timestamp in yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS UTC format.
markdown prior price. Retail price before markdown.
Gate 1 markdown price. Retail price on markdown at gate 1. It is equal to the current retail price if the week end date falls in between gate 1 start and end date.
Gate 2 markdown price. Retail price on markdown at gate 2. It is equal to the current retail price if the week end date falls in between gate 2 start and end date. Gate 2 starts after gate 1 ends.
Sales quantity (units) at the end of the week.
Sales amount (dollars) at the end of the week.
Starting on-hands quantity/ inventory (units) at the start of the week.
Ending on-hands quantity/ inventory (units) at the end of the week.
Plan running week number starting at 1
